name: Morgan Espitia
title: Software Engineer
summary: Software engineer since 2017, with six years of full-stack experience in PHP, Node, React and TypeScript: websites for credit unions, the backend of a healthcare-benefits platform handling medical and financial data, and an enterprise shipping-data dashboard. Independent since 2023, with client work under NDA and 17 public projects, from web apps and APIs to a compiler and audio software. I own features end to end, from the interface to the service behind it.

bullets: Client and contract work under NDA: blockchain infrastructure and full-stack product work, including deployment, debugging and ongoing support.

Built and run TokenSafe, a production Node/TypeScript API that scores Solana tokens from on-chain data and charges per request with x402 micropayments, and Scry, its React web UI and Telegram bot. Deployed with Docker, with Prometheus metrics and structured logs.
Built Perennials, an offline-first React/TypeScript app backed by a Node/PostgreSQL service that searches about 8,800 plants by growing conditions; every search is a shareable URL.

Maintain the public projects at ampactor.dev, including a self-hosting compiler, a DSP library that runs both as a desktop plugin and on a Cortex-M7 microcontroller, a SIMD sort published on crates.io, a Solana transaction crate whose CI sends live transactions, and a dozen browser apps and games.
Built WordPress sites, custom business tooling, migration systems and automated recurring processes.
Built and maintained the PHP dashboard enterprise IT teams use to manage and stream product-shipping data.
Maintained its asynchronous Node.js backend (WebSockets, RabbitMQ); overhauled CI/CD and onboarding, cutting build failures by about 30%.
Engineered the PHP backend of a healthcare-benefits platform handling sensitive medical and financial data.
Built fault-tolerant synchronization pipelines with Salesforce and maintained high-throughput backend workflows.
Built and maintained the PHP ticket-management system used across the customer-service organization: messaging, escalation and workflow features.
Built and shipped PHP websites for credit unions and other clients, including OASCU and National Geographic's credit union.
